title: Execution of statements.
bodyText: Each statement or document required by this chapter to be filed with the director of commerce and consumer affairs shall be signed and certified by at least one partner.
bodyHtml: [§425-1.8]  Execution of statements.  Each statement or document required by this chapter to be filed with the director of commerce and consumer affairs shall be signed and certified by at least one partner. [L 2002, c 130, pt of §5]
